summary: Verified partner Wallet & Withdraw UI fix on Expo web (ngrok). KPI cards now render EXACTLY 2-per-row (row1: total-earned + incentives at same y=548, differing x=16 vs 213.6; row2: processing at y=716). KYC blocker renders cleanly (amber bg, alert icon, wrapped title, 'Pending:' subtitle, full-width 44px CTA). Backend sanity: all 4 wallet GET endpoints return 200 with partner bearer token.

integration_issues.flow: Wallet data hydration on first render
integration_issues.issue: Screenshot showed balance ₹0.00 and 'Pending: verification' fallback while backend returns 449.25 and blockers=['PAN card not verified','No verified bank account']. Likely stale render before react-query resolved (page was refreshed via direct nav). Not blocking the layout fix; retest after fresh login flow if concerning.

verification_details.row_check: kpi-total-earned and kpi-incentives share y=548 with x-delta=197.6 (side-by-side). kpi-processing on next row at y=716. PASS: exactly 2-per-row on 412px width.

kyc_blocker.visual: amber bg (#FFFBEB) + amber border (#FCD34D), 40px alert icon, title 'Complete Bank & KYC to withdraw', 'Pending: ...' subtitle, full-width blue CTA — clean, nothing cropped

critical_code_review_comments: KpiCard width='48%' with justifyContent='space-between' and rowGap:12 correctly produces 2-per-row on RN-web. Good fix.
Minor: 'Pending: {fin.blockers.join(...) || 'verification'}' fallback triggers when blockers array is empty; consider showing 'Complete Bank & KYC' details only after kycQ resolves to avoid flicker.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expo web via ngrok requires ngrok-skip-browser-warning header and ~5-8s bundle wait. Onboarding may redirect to /onboarding/intro then /onboarding/notifications; the wallet route /wallet is reachable directly if partner session token is present. Backend auth endpoint is /api/auth/send-otp and /api/auth/verify-otp; verify-otp returns {token, user} (not access_token).
